expected.reason: Lines 517-523: unlike the disabled-sibling case above, an EXISTING ACTIVE jar is skipped from re-downloading but IS still passed through classifyAndDisableManifestJar -- so a re-import against a pack whose Modrinth server_side classification changed since the file was first placed can newly disable a previously-enabled, already-installed jar without ever re-downloading it.

notes: This is a genuine asymmetry between the two 'already present' branches (disabled = frozen forever, active = re-evaluated every re-import) worth preserving exactly, not smoothing into one shared behavior during the port.
